      HOW PRICES GET HERE

      Browse the FM, prices fill in.

      Players open Live FM Scanner, share their game window and walk the Free Market as usual. Every shop they open is read on their own computer; only item names, prices and the shop name are sent. Nothing clicks or reads game memory.

      1. Asking priceWhat a shop lists an item for. Lowest and typical (median) are shown separately.
      2. Reviewed saleA reported sale reviewed with supporting evidence. Client OCR alone does not verify a trade.
      3. FreshnessEvery number shows when it was last seen. Old data is marked stale, never hidden.

              Keep the game at its normal size and the shop window unobstructed. Hover an item to capture its stats from the tooltip. A listing is only shared after two matching reads, so pause a moment on each shop.

                NEW MEGAPHONE

                Write your megaphone

                  Preview

                  Secure checkout by Stripe. While the site is in test mode no real money is taken; use Stripe’s test card 4242 4242 4242 4242.

                  HOW IT WORKS
                  • Rotation: every live megaphone gets an equal turn under the search bar, 8 seconds each, in a loop.
                  • Price: $1 for 1 hour, $2 for 2.5 hours, $4 for 6 hours, $7 for 12 hours, $12 for 24 hours. The longer you buy, the less each hour costs (up to 50% off).
                  • Your time: the hours you buy are real time in that rotation, counted from when it goes live.
                  • Review first: after payment a moderator approves it; your time starts then, not at payment.
                  • Slots: at most 8 run at once. If all are taken, yours is queued and starts as soon as one frees up, so you always get the full time.
                  • Rules: no links, no real-money trading, nothing offensive. Rejected megaphones are refunded.

                        ITEM DATABASE

                        Catalog updates

                        The MapleStory Classic item list is downloaded every day at 06:17 UTC and applied only when it changed, so new items from a game patch appear within a day. A broken download is never applied.

                          ITEM DATABASE

                          Community items to review

                          Names read from shops that are not in the catalog. Correct the name, add the game item ID if you know it, and verify.

                            Privacy, sources & limitations

                            Screen reading happens in your browser with Tesseract.js (loaded from jsDelivr). Nothing clicks, types or reads game memory. Live FM Scanner sends item names, per-item prices, quantities, stats read from tooltips, shop titles and FM room names, plus small item pictures for items without one, under an anonymous ID. My Store sends reviewed sales only if you turn that on. Your Discord webhook stays in page memory and goes only to Discord.

                            Item data: names, IDs, categories, base stats and item pictures are MapleStory Classic World game data from OSMS Data Explorer, used under CC BY 4.0 (untradeable and quest items left out). That data has no NX items, so NX items come from shop scans: a name not in the catalog becomes a community item with its picture cropped from the shop, and admins confirm it as NX. Game data and images © NEXON. NiaDB (meowdb.com) data is not used: its reuse policy requires permission first.

                            Prices are what shops ask unless marked as a reviewed sale. OCR can misread; listings must read the same twice before they count, and a single player cannot move a median on their own. Hidden tabs are throttled by the browser.
